category: hosted bot (Telegram file to permanent link)

free_tier.stated: Free, no account: 'The ultimate Bot for permanent Links to Telegram Files.' paired with a companion channel @OpenFileZ. No quota is published.

per_object_cap.stated: Not published. Telegram's 2 GB per object is the only ceiling in evidence.

retention.stated: 'permanent Links' is the claim; no expiry is stated and none was tested.
retention.notes: 'permanent' is the operator's word, not a measured lifetime

egress.terms: Free HTTP links over the operator's session; no byte allowance is stated.

interface_detail: A Telegram chat plus a link domain (tgdl.eu.org) named in the bot's title.
tooling: Any Telegram client; the output is a URL.
chaining: Parks a Telegram object behind a stable HTTP name, which is the only way a 2 GB file becomes fetchable by curl without a bot token.

limits.value: 2 GB, Telegram's own object ceiling; the bot states none

binding_note: Nothing tighter is published; the operator's rate limiting is unknown, so the platform ceiling is the only defensible binding.

identity_cost.detail: A Telegram account to message the bot; no key or email.

reliability_note: A single-operator service whose permanence claim is untested; the domain in the title is the single point of failure.
confidence_note: Description read. Whether a link survives a week is unverified.

evidence.proved: 'The ultimate Bot for permanent Links to Telegram Files.' and the @OpenFileZ companion

notes: Grouped with @FileToLinkTGbot as a class: free file-to-URL bots that exist to defeat the 20 MB getFile cap. Abandon the pair together if either stops resolving, and prefer whichever states a real quota.
